claim: The overview excludes full NPs as pre-head dependents in its discussion of nominal modifiers.
evidence_summary: CGEL gives full NP status to measure genitives and to all girls’ in an all girls’ school.
finding: Qualify the generalization for genitive attributes. The plain-case institutional examples still distinguish nominal from NP.
inference: Does the restriction on ordinary attributive nouns extend to genitive NPs before a head?

evidence.passage: §2, p. 329. The overview excludes full NPs as pre-head dependents in its discussion of nominal modifiers.
evidence.example: The Ministry of Defence officials example tests plain-case noun modification. At p. 444 CGEL permits a full measure genitive, and on p. 470 assigns NP status to all girls’ in an all girls’ school.
evidence.establishes: The chapter itself supplies a pre-head NP outside the plain-case pattern. The Ministry of Defence contrast can retain its narrower use.
evidence.note: Local source (working note, unpublished draft or local copy); not online.
